summary: Iteration 5 verified the 2 new items and regression. Backend: full pytest suite 21/21 PASS. NEW TestReviews (3 tests) — GET /api/reviews returns {success:true, count:35, average:5.0, reviews:[35 items]}, every review has non-empty name+text, rating int in [0,5], avatar/date keys present. UPDATED TestContact — POST /api/contact returns {success:true, message:'Message received', forwarded:<bool>} (forwarded currently False because upstream https://airbcars.ma/api/email_endpoint.php?type=contact returns 500 server-side — expected & OK; local copy still persisted to db.contacts). 422 on missing 'message'. Regression classes all green: /api/cars listing+filters (category/transmission/price-range), /api/cars/{id} 404 + franchise_fee enrichment, pagination page1/page2 distinct ids, /api/car-price (3d=+40% supplement, 5d=0% supplement), real /api/bookings CSRF+session flow (booking_number+pin_code returned) + 422 validation, /api/featured-cars (12 ids overlap homepage). Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667): /car/313 loads correctly, scrolling to bottom reveals testID='reviews-section' with 35 horizontally-scrollable review cards (review-0 … review-34), no red screen, no console errors, sticky bottom bar still shows price + WhatsApp + book-now-btn. Contact regression: filled form submits and success screen 'Message envoyé !' with contact-back-home button appears. No deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch packages detected. Non-blocking cosmetic RN-Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' / 'props.pointerEvents') persist from previous iterations — not surfaced this run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.get_reviews caches scraped reviews for 30 min (_reviews_cache); regex-based parsing tolerates missing avatar/date but requires name+text (correct). Rating computed via count of 'star-filled' capped at 5 — matches homepage structure returning 35 five-star reviews (avg=5.0).

POST /api/contact stores a copy locally regardless of forwarding status — resilient to the upstream mail server 500. Response contract clean: {success, message, forwarded}. Pydantic ContactCreate enforces required name/email/message → 422 on missing (verified).

Reviews.tsx correctly guards render when reviews.length===0 (returns null), uses horizontal ScrollView with gap+paddingRight, and every card has testID={`review-${i}`}. Google logo pill shows average.toFixed(1) + star rating rounded + count.
car/[id].tsx integrates <Reviews /> below description inside the ScrollView with marginTop spacing.xl — correct placement per spec ('below the description').
